name: Поля й загроза рентгенівської атаки
description:
This lesson we take a look at the skewer. By attacking both a piece and a square on which a skewer can be performed, material can be gained. See the example.

What do you have to do?

Win material by attacking both a piece and a square on which a skewer can be performed.

examples.pgn: {[#]} 1. Qe5 $1 {[%csl Ra5,Rh8]} Bxc3 2. Qh8+ Ke7 3. Qxc8 *
examples.text: 1.Qe5! attacks the bishop and square h8. After 1...Bxc3 2.Qh8+ the x-ray attack wins a rook: 2...Ke7 3.Qxc8. A move like 1...Re8 is better, but then white takes the bishop and has also wins material!

texts: Use your queen to create an x-ray.
